title: Plans & Pricing | Amigo — AI Career Companion & Interview Copilot
description: Flexible pricing for Amigo's AI interview copilot: pay-as-you-go minutes packs, or an optional monthly Unlimited subscription. Start with a 10-minute free trial.
html:
Amigo offers two independent pricing models: flexible, credit-based packs (buy minutes once, they stay in your account until used, with no monthly reset), and an optional monthly Unlimited subscription for unlimited session access. All plans include Stealth Mode, real-time AI suggestions, and access to all available AI models.

Free Plan

The Free plan gives you 10 minutes of credits to try Amigo at no cost. It's a great way to run a practice session and get a feel for the product before buying a pack.

Free credits never expire. There is no monthly reset, so what you get is yours to use whenever you're ready.

Starter: $15.00

2 hours of interview credits for $15.00 ($0.125 per minute). A good fit for a single interview process or a couple of practice runs.

Essential: $33.75 (Most Popular)

5 hours of credits for $33.75 ($0.113 per minute). The most popular choice for active job seekers running multiple interview loops at the same time.

  • Includes priority support.
  • Best value per minute among the mid-tier packs.
  • Credits never expire, so you can use them across multiple interview processes.

Scale: $127.50

20 hours of credits for $127.50 ($0.106 per minute), the lowest price per minute available. Ideal if you have a long job search or want to stock up in advance.

  • Includes priority support.
  • Lowest per-minute rate across all packs.
  • Credits never expire.

Enterprise

Need credits for a recruiting team, bootcamp, or organisation supporting multiple candidates? Contact us at support@amigohelp.ai for volume pricing and custom arrangements.

Billing

  • All prices are in USD. VAT or local taxes may apply depending on your region.
  • Payment is processed via Stripe. We accept all major credit and debit cards.
  • Receipts are sent to your registered email address and are available in Account Settings → Billing.
  • Minutes pack purchases are one-time payments with no recurring charge. The optional Unlimited subscription renews monthly until cancelled.
  • Unused minutes can be refunded within 30 days of purchase. Contact support@amigohelp.ai.

Not sure how many minutes you need? Start on Free, run a practice session, then pick the pack that fits your interview load. You can top up any time from the Buy Minutes page.
